This constellation of features is highly characteristic of an IDH-mutant glioma. However, its absence does not rule out an IDH-mutant status, as oligodendrogliomas (which are IDH-mutant) typically lack this sign. Given the overwhelming evidence from the patient's age and the non-aggressive tumor appearance, an IDH-mutant prediction is most appropriate.
